# scc_global_list (Data Source)

Look up an existing GlobalList object. Set identity or name to select it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identity` (String) Identity used to look up the object.
- `name` (String) Maps to the -Name parameter.

### Read-Only

- `add_items` (String) Maps to the -AddItems parameter.
- `comment` (String) Maps to the -Comment parameter.
- `global_list_type` (String) Maps to the -GlobalListType parameter.
- `global_list_value` (String) Maps to the -GlobalListValue parameter.
- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
- `organization` (String) Maps to the -Organization parameter.
- `remove_items` (String) Maps to the -RemoveItems parameter.
